title: Tanner's Run boardwalk replacement
funding: City capital budget and a state recreation trails grant
timeline: Built in three sections, Sep to Dec 2026
meeting: None scheduled; construction updates on the conditions board
summary: The 1994 boardwalk is being replaced with a wider, step-free deck on helical piles that sit lightly in the wetland.
body:
Sections 1 and 2 reopened in October. Section 3 is under construction and should reopen in early December.

The new deck is 8 feet wide, with passing places and two rebuilt bird blinds.

title: All-abilities Commons Playground
funding: City capital budget, county parks levy and the Friends of Cadwallow Park ($240,000)
meeting: Bid opening, Dec 11, 2026, 10:00 am, park office
summary: A new playground on the South Commons designed with families of children with disabilities.
body:
The design came from four public workshops and a parent advisory group. It includes a ground-level play loop, a wheelchair-accessible merry-go-round, quiet spaces and shade.

The current playground stays open until the contractor takes the site in spring.

title: Wallow shoreline restoration
funding: State water quality grant (applied), city stormwater fund
timeline: Design through spring 2027; construction depends on the grant
meeting: Public design meeting, Jan 14, 2027, 6:30 pm, Warming Hut
summary: Replacing eroding concrete edging with planted shelves that clean the water and give the shore back to herons and turtles.
body: The Wallow's concrete edge was poured in 1958 and is failing in places. The design keeps a hard edge where people sit and fish, and plants the rest.

title: Long Meadow prairie conversion
funding: Friends of Cadwallow Park and volunteer labor
timeline: Planning in 2026–27; first plots seeded fall 2027
meeting: Friends of the park annual meeting, Feb 2027
summary: Turning the outer edges of the Long Meadow into native prairie, a plot at a time, while keeping the mown middle for play.
body: Eight trial plots planted by volunteers since 2023 have shown which species do well. The full plan covers 14 of the meadow's 41 acres.

title: Elm Walk lighting
summary: New warm-white, dark-sky lighting along the Elm Walk, from the East Gate to the boathouse.
body: The fixtures point down and are dimmed after 10:00 pm. Energy use is down by about two thirds.
